name: stega-now
description: stega.now — the stegassette player, editor and galleries

scripts.codec: cp node_modules/@amplib/steganography/dist/stegassette.global.js lib/stegassette.js && cp node_modules/@amplib/steganography/dist/jobSchema.global.js lib/stegassette-jobs.js && node -e "for(const f of process.argv.slice(1)){const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/\\n?\\/\\/# sourceMappingURL=.*$/,''))}" lib/stegassette.js lib/stegassette-jobs.js
